SELECT p.sku, p.name,
       SUM(ds.revenue_inr) AS total_revenue,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sa.status = 'on shelf' THEN sa.audit_ts END) AS on_shelf_audits,
       SUM(ds.revenue_inr) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sa.status = 'on shelf' THEN sa.audit_ts END),0) AS revenue_per_on_shelf_audit
FROM store.products p
JOIN store.daily_sales ds ON p.sku = ds.sku
LEFT JOIN store.shelf_audits sa ON p.sku = sa.sku
GROUP BY p.sku, p.name
ORDER BY revenue_per_on_shelf_audit DESC
LIMIT 10;
